```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const toggle = e.target.closest(".pub-toggle");
  if (toggle) {
    const abs = document.getElementById(toggle.getAttribute("aria-controls"));
    const open = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!open));
    abs.hidden = open;
  }
});

// "In the media": one outreach.yml entry whose `related` names the paper, then
// a "+N" button that reveals the rest in place. Shown first: the entry marked
// `highlight` (most prominent outlet), else the one with the most of my own
// involvement (op-ed > interview > podcast/radio > citation), newest first
// within that (data from the pub-media listing, already newest first)
const mentions = [...document.querySelectorAll("#pub-media-data li")].map((li) => ({
  type: li.dataset.type, related: li.dataset.related.split(" "), highlight: "highlight" in li.dataset,
  outlet: li.textContent, title: li.title, url: li.dataset.url,
}));
document.querySelectorAll(".pub").forEach((p) => {
  const id = p.id.replace(/^pub-/, "");
  const ms = mentions.filter((m) => m.related.includes(id));
  if (!ms.length) return;
  const involvement = { "op-ed": 0, interview: 1, podcast: 2, radio: 2, reference: 3 };
  const rank = (m) => (m.highlight ? -1 : involvement[m.type] ?? 4);
  const top = ms.reduce((a, b) => (rank(b) < rank(a) ? b : a));
  const rest = ms.filter((m) => m !== top);
  const link = (m) => {
    const el = document.createElement(m.url ? "a" : "span");
    el.textContent = m.outlet;
    if (m.url) { el.href = m.url; el.title = m.title; el.target = "_blank"; el.rel = "noopener"; }
    return el;
  };
  const line = document.createElement("p");
  line.className = "pub-media";
  line.append("In the media: ", link(top));
  if (rest.length) {
    const more = document.createElement("span");
    more.className = "pub-media-rest";
    more.hidden = true;
    rest.forEach((m) => more.append(", ", link(m)));
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.className = "pub-media-more";
    btn.setAttribute("aria-label", `Show ${rest.length} more`);
    btn.textContent = `+${rest.length}`;
    // One way: the button gives way to the full list
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      more.hidden = false;
      btn.remove();
    });
    line.append(more, " ", btn);
  }
  p.querySelector(".pub-venue").after(line);
});

// Key-finding figures: grow the thumbnail into a near-full-screen view and
// shrink it back on click or Esc
const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  const thumb = e.target.closest(".pub-fig img");
  if (thumb) zoomFigure(thumb);
});
function zoomFigure(thumb) {
  const ratio = thumb.naturalWidth / thumb.naturalHeight;
  const w = Math.min(window.innerWidth * 0.94, window.innerHeight * 0.9 * ratio);
  const h = w / ratio;
  const left = (window.innerWidth - w) / 2, top = (window.innerHeight - h) / 2;
  // Transform that places the big image exactly over the thumbnail
  const overThumb = () => {
    const r = thumb.getBoundingClientRect();
    return `translate(${r.left - left}px, ${r.top - top}px) scale(${r.width / w})`;
  };
  const back = document.createElement("div");
  back.className = "fig-zoom-back";
  const img = document.createElement("img");
  img.className = "fig-zoom-img";
  img.src = thumb.currentSrc || thumb.src;
  img.alt = thumb.alt;
  Object.assign(img.style, { left: left + "px", top: top + "px", width: w + "px", height: h + "px", transform: overThumb() });
  document.body.append(back, img);
  thumb.style.visibility = "hidden";
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    back.classList.add("open");
    img.style.transform = "none";
  }));
  const done = () => { img.remove(); back.remove(); thumb.style.visibility = ""; };
  const close = () => {
    document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    back.classList.remove("open");
    if (reduceMotion) return done();
    img.style.transform = overThumb();
    img.addEventListener("transitionend", done, { once: true });
  };
  const onKey = (ev) => { if (ev.key === "Escape") close(); };
  back.addEventListener("click", close);
  img.addEventListener("click", close);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
}
</script>
```
